name: Project switcher
author: Brett
description: Separate workspaces: each project has its own builds, notes, to-dos, tasks, lists and plans, and a new one starts empty. AmberX AXF holds everything from before projects. Duplicate any project (its settings, build rules, skin, Claude accounts, plugin setup, manifest, rules and instructions; lists, to-dos, notes and plans as structure only unless you pick everything; builds history optional) or save it as a named boilerplate shared across projects, then start new projects from it. Banner chip shows the active project; tap it, the app menu (Builds → Project), the right-click menu or Settings → Plugins → Projects to switch, start a new project, rename, archive or delete one (archive and delete ask you to type its id; the data stays on disk). Projects are framework data (framework/cli/projects.mjs, projects@1): removing this plugin leaves them and their data in place.

items.title: List projects
items.description: Every project with its build counts and which one is active (voice: 'what projects do I have').

items.title: Active project
items.description: The project the console, AmberX and every build list work on now (voice: 'which project am I in').

items.title: New project
items.description: Start a new, empty project with its own builds, notes, to-dos, tasks, lists and plans, and switch to it (voice: 'new project called Garden'). select false keeps the current one active.

id.description: optional id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes (default: from the name)

items.title: Switch project
items.description: Make another project the active one, for every device and session (voice: 'switch to project AmberX AXF'). Running builds of other projects keep running.

items.title: Rename a project
items.description: Change a project's name or description (voice: 'rename project garden to Garden Planner').

items.title: Archive a project
items.description: Take a project off the switcher; its data stays and its queued builds stop being dispatched. confirm must be the project id (tell Brett first). AmberX AXF can't be archived.

confirm.description: the project id, typed to confirm

items.title: Unarchive a project
items.description: Put an archived project back on the switcher (voice: 'bring back project garden').

items.title: Delete a project
items.description: Take a project off the list for good; its data folders stay on disk (create a project with the same id to get it back). confirm must be the project id (tell Brett first). AmberX AXF can't be deleted.

confirm.description: the project id, typed to confirm

items.title: Duplicate a project
items.description: A new project that starts from this one (voice: 'duplicate this project', 'copy project Garden as Garden Two'): its settings, build rules, skin, Claude accounts, plugin setup, manifest under the new name, rules and instructions. Lists, to-dos, notes and plans carry their structure only unless items is all. Name default '<project> copy'; it becomes the active project unless select is false.

project.description: project id or name (default the active one)

items.description: lists, to-dos, notes and plans: structure (default: lists and folders, no items), all, or none

builds.description: bring the builds history along, read-only (default false)

items.title: List boilerplates
items.description: Saved project boilerplates, shared across projects (voice: 'what boilerplates do I have').

items.title: Save as boilerplate
items.description: Keep a project (default the active one) as a named boilerplate new projects can start from (voice: 'save this project as a boilerplate called Client site').

project.description: project id or name (default the active one)

items.description: lists, to-dos, notes and plans: structure (default: lists and folders, no items), all, or none

builds.description: bring the builds history along, read-only (default false)

items.title: Update a boilerplate
items.description: Take a project's current state into a boilerplate again (default: the project it came from). Its name and owner stay.
lists, to-dos, notes and plans: structure (default: lists and folders, no items), all, or none

builds.description: bring the builds history along, read-only (default false)

items.title: Rename a boilerplate
items.description: Change a boilerplate's name or description.

items.title: Delete a boilerplate
items.description: Remove a saved boilerplate for good (projects made from it keep everything). confirm must be the boilerplate id; Brett can veto it (tell him first).

confirm.description: the boilerplate id, typed to confirm

items.title: New project from a boilerplate
items.description: Start a new project from a saved boilerplate (voice: 'new project from the Client site boilerplate'). For a new repo too, use the New project wizard's Start from.
